b.paid: the third Thursday of each month, for the days since the previous one (exclusive) to that day (inclusive)

c.paid: each weekday the same day; a weekend day's amount on the Monday after

d.paid: on the 15th, for every day of that month

e.paid: the month's Tuesdays' amount spread evenly over the month's weekdays

f.paid: on the day, or the Friday before if it is a weekend day

g.paid: the first weekday of even months, the third weekday of odd months

h.paid: every Wednesday: the day before if in the month's first 10 days, the day after if in its last 10 days
